fusions.name: Pulled Thread
fusions.desc: Hooks a loose thread and runs with it, dealing 20 damage and leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Flashed Scut
fusions.desc: Snaps a white cloth out in a flash, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 0.8 seconds. Each has a 40% chance to be confused for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of the Hat
fusions.desc: After a 1 second cast, pulls a hare out from under a cloth. It fights beside you for 18 seconds, kicking an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Empty Sleeve
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
